augments.name: Third Eye Lens
augments.desc: See the shot before it lands: +7% evasion.

events.text: A very old Sloog sits alone in a bubble ship. "Ask me one question," it gurgles. "Only one."

effect.text: It points. There is, in fact, treasure.
It describes the whole sector, beacon by beacon.
"Look harder." It hands you a strange lens.
It sighs very deeply and closes its bubble.

events.text: Your crew all had the same dream last night: a beacon, a ship and a door that opens inward.

effect.text: The beacon is real. It is marked on your map.
{who} says it was a Sloog prank. The pranksters send a box of supplies to apologise.

events.text: The dream beacon. A door floats in empty space, with no ship and no station around it. It opens inward.

success.text: They come back an hour later with an armful of loot and no memory of where they went.

fail.text: They come back an hour older and very upset. And something followed them.

effect.text: Someone on the other side knocks back. Then the door closes, and a crate is left where it was.

events.text: A Sloog thought-trader offers to buy one of your crew's memories. "A happy one, preferably."

choices.text: Sell a memory of a nice lunch.

effect.text: Nobody can remember what they had for lunch. You are richer, though.
Your gunners now remember a lifetime of target practice.
